evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 begins rising from ~5 ppm baseline to 13.2 ppm during growth
O2 continues monotonic climb: 19.4 -> 27.1 -> 33.2 ppm despite stable Ar flow
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so rise is not a purge-flow change
Temperature holding setpoint 750 °C with nominal heater power

args.missing_evidence: Whether O2 keeps rising (leak) or plateaus/decays (transient outgassing); a leak-check at constant flow or Ar flow step to test dilution response would discriminate.
